sources.title: Accessory Solutions
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current Olympus America page names WM-NP3 and KV-6 exactly as featured accessory products.
sources.factual_summary: Olympus America currently includes the WM-NP3 workstation and KV-6 suction pump on its U.S. accessory-solutions page.
sources.limitations: The page supports only a subset of SRC022. Exact workstation sets, tubing, and other accessories require their own current product or ordering tables.

sources.title: Spiration Valve System — Product Order Information
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The U.S. order-information sheet lists exact REF-HUS valve, sizing-kit, and deployment-catheter numbers for the humanitarian-use air-leak configuration.
sources.factual_summary: Olympus America's 2020 U.S. ordering sheet exactly identifies the Spiration Valve System humanitarian-use device configurations in SRC040.
sources.limitations: The document is dated 2020 and does not prove current ordering availability. The current severe-emphysema valve page uses a different SVS catalog-number pattern and must not be conflated with the HUS air-leak configuration.

sources.title: Reprocessing Products
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current U.S. page continues to name OER-Pro and its dedicated Acecide-C chemistry, but it does not enumerate the older MAJ accessory catalog numbers.
sources.factual_summary: Olympus America currently retains OER-Pro in its U.S. reprocessing-products portfolio alongside OER-Elite.
sources.limitations: This source does not establish current sale or replacement availability for MAJ-824 or the other SRC039 accessories and should be combined with exact legacy evidence rather than used alone.

sources.title: Peripheral Bronchoscopy with Radial EBUS
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current U.S. procedure page names exact models BF-XP190 and EU-ME3 among the featured peripheral-bronchoscopy products.
sources.factual_summary: Olympus America currently presents BF-XP190, EU-ME3, radial probes, PeriView FLEX, and related guide-sheath products as part of its peripheral bronchoscopy solution.
sources.limitations: The page does not expose all exact accessory order numbers in SRC029; those require current specifications or ordering documents. Family-level presentation is not proof that every older accessory remains distributed.

sources.title: EVIS EXERA Bronchoscopy — Visualization
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current Olympus America product page names both BF-H190 and BF-1TH190 exactly as bronchoscopes in the EVIS EXERA III portfolio.
sources.factual_summary: Olympus America currently presents BF-H190 and BF-1TH190 as members of its U.S. bronchoscopy portfolio.
sources.limitations: The page confirms model-level portfolio presence, not a purchasable configuration, inventory, or orderability on a particular date.

sources.title: OER-Pro Automated Endoscope Reprocessor
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The printed U.S. brochure contains exact MAJ catalog numbers for the OER-Pro filters, paper, ID components, and connector hanger.
sources.factual_summary: The official Olympus America brochure exactly identifies the legacy OER-Pro accessory references represented in SRC039.
sources.limitations: The brochure is copyrighted 2015 and printed under a 2016-era document code. It supplies identity evidence only; it cannot establish current accessory distribution or service support.

sources.title: EWS — Endobronchial Watanabe-Spigots
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current manufacturer page contains an ordering-information table with all four exact 01EWS references.
sources.factual_summary: NOVATECH currently lists all four EWS configurations from SRC041 with sizes, quantities, and exact references.
sources.limitations: The page is global rather than U.S.-specific and does not state U.S. authorization, distribution, or ordering availability. Current global identity cannot be promoted to current U.S. status.

sources.title: STERITALC
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current manufacturer page provides exact REF ordering information for F2, F4, PF3, and PF3 Supplement and separately states that STERITALC is approved in the United States.
sources.factual_summary: NOVATECH currently lists all four STERITALC references in SRC042 and explicitly describes U.S. FDA approval of STERITALC.
sources.limitations: The page does not explicitly map each European-style REF to the U.S. NDC/package configurations or state that every REF is currently distributed in the United States. Exact U.S. package mapping remains required.

sources.title: Arrow Diagnostic and Drainage Products
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The U.S. brochure provides exact REF values and kit descriptions for Arrow-Clarke thoracentesis, Drainer centesis, pneumothorax, and cavity-drainage products.
sources.factual_summary: The official U.S. brochure exactly identifies multiple SRC031 products and includes U.S. contact and federal-sale language.
sources.limitations: The document is Rev 0, revised December 2020. Continued hosting does not prove that every referenced kit remains currently distributed, so it is historical corroboration pending a newer ordering source.

sources.factual_summary: The active Erbe U.S. catalog identifies exact connecting-cable references and their connector standards and lengths.
sources.limitations: A broad catalog entry does not establish that every country-specific cable or adapter is currently stocked in the United States. Exact U.S. sales availability still requires confirmation.

sources.title: ERBECRYO 2 with Flexible Single-Use Cryoprobes
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The U.S. brochure's product-data table gives exact product numbers for the cryoprobes and ERBECRYO 2 accessories.
sources.factual_summary: Erbe USA's June 2023 brochure identifies the ERBECRYO 2 system, three single-use cryoprobes, and related accessories by exact product number.
sources.limitations: The brochure remains official U.S. evidence but is not a live ordering system and does not state stock, orderability, or whether every accessory remains distributed without change.

sources.title: Arndt Endobronchial Blocker Set
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current U.S. product table maps exact Cook order numbers to exact Arndt reference part numbers and sizes.
sources.factual_summary: Cook's current page states U.S. sale availability and lists three Arndt Endobronchial Blocker Set order numbers from SRC023.
sources.limitations: The page does not include the Cohen blocker order number G44122, so that product requires a separate current official page. Page presence does not establish inventory.

sources.title: Wayne Pneumothorax Catheter Set and Tray
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current U.S. product specification table maps exact Cook order numbers to reference part numbers for the Seldinger and trocar sets.
sources.factual_summary: Cook's current page states that products on the site are available for sale in the United States and lists G56532 and G56535 in the Wayne Pneumothorax line.
sources.limitations: This page directly covers two products in SRC020; the other drainage-set catalog numbers need their corresponding Cook product pages. It does not establish inventory or immediate shipment.

sources.title: Ion Endoluminal System — Reach More Now
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The U.S. Rev A brochure maps exact 490-series order numbers to the catheter, vision probe, and 19G, 21G, and 23G Flexision biopsy needles.
sources.factual_summary: The 2019 U.S. launch brochure states that Ion was for sale in the United States and provides the exact legacy instrument and accessory numbers represented in SRC037.
sources.limitations: This is historical Rev A evidence. Current Intuitive materials show changed catheter and vision-probe SKU generations, so the 2019 catalog numbers must not be treated as current without newer exact-SKU corroboration.

sources.title: Ion Robotic Bronchoscopy
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The current U.S. page exactly names the Ion Endoluminal System and its catheter, peripheral vision probe, and Flexision needle family, but does not display the older 490-series order numbers.
sources.factual_summary: Intuitive currently presents Ion and its instrument families on its U.S. product site and identifies the system model as IF1000.
sources.limitations: The current page supports product-family continuity, not continuity of catalog number 490105 or the other 2019 order numbers. Exact current SKU mapping remains necessary.

sources.title: Thoracic Surgery
sources.exact_identifier_basis: No exact SRC030 catalog numbers appear on the current U.S. page; it confirms only the manufacturer, specialty, and continued U.S. thoracic portfolio context.
sources.factual_summary: KARL STORZ currently maintains a U.S. thoracic-surgery page and online-catalog route for thoracoscopy, VATS, and mediastinoscopy products.
sources.limitations: The source does not corroborate the exact identifiers imported from the 2011 SRC030 catalog. The page also instructs users to contact the local subsidiary for local approval and availability, so all exact-SKU U.S. statuses remain unresolved.

sources.title: Tracheal/Bronchial Stents
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The official product page contains an ordering table with exact ST02 catalog references and dimensions.
sources.factual_summary: Micro-Tech's current global product page lists the tracheal/bronchial stent family and exact ST02 reference numbers.
sources.limitations: This is not a U.S.-specific page. The current Micro-Tech Endoscopy USA catalog page does not expose this airway-stent family, so the source cannot establish current U.S. distribution.

sources.title: Bronchoscopy / Thoracoscopy / Mediastinoscopy — Thoracic Endoscopy
sources.exact_identifier_basis: The VI25 manufacturer catalog provides exact product numbers in bronchoscope, telescope, TipControl, forceps, and thoracic-instrument tables.
sources.factual_summary: Richard Wolf's VI25 thoracic endoscopy catalog identifies the current global catalog family and exact product numbers represented in SRC021.
sources.limitations: The catalog explicitly warns that some products may not be available in all countries. It is not U.S.-specific and therefore cannot establish current U.S. distribution without a U.S. source or direct confirmation.

sources.limitations: The page is not explicitly labeled for a U.S. audience and does not state current regional orderability, configuration, software license, or transducer availability.
